## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.22

This stable release rolls up the v1.4.21 pre-releases, including the camera live-view repair confirmed in v1.4.21.6.

### Cameras
- Restores the earlier working live-view signaling flow for Home Assistant native WebRTC.
- Keeps the multi-Home camera ticket identity handling used by live view, recording history, and event history.
- Keeps redacted diagnostics for ticket selection, signaling room identity, received signaling frames, and session cleanup.
- Retains cleanup safeguards for cancelled or replaced live-view sessions.
